The creator will quit from the CN on the 30th day after initiating the quit notice. During this period, creator and CN could submit materials, and the platform will determine who is at fault. If the CN has no responsibility, the creator will have a 60 day cooling-off period after leaving the CN (cannot join any CN), and the platform will provide additional fee for the corresponding CN for 60 days; If the CN is at fault, there will be no cooling off period after the creator quits

The Creator Network bootcamp is a learning and growth module designed for new Creator Networks on LIVE Backstage. It features a mission system centered around the core objectives of Creator Network operations. In the bootcamp, you can learn relevant courses, complete the missions, and get rewards. You will discover best practices for the livestreaming business, the platform, and how to scout and manage creators. This bootcamp helps you quickly get started with running a Creator Network.
Health Score is a rating system (from 0 to 100) to evaluate an creator network's operational compliance on the platform based on the Agency Service Agreement and display to each CN.
